title: INVERT: Controlled Process-Signature Auditing — Replication Package
description: Replication package for the manuscript: “Auditing Process Signatures in Behaviorally Equivalent Generated Code: A Controlled Empirical Protocol.” This release archives the generated programs, transformed artifacts, traces, task configurations, deterministic auditors, baseline analyses, provenance metadata, and offline validation scripts supporting the study. Version 2.1.1 preserves the scientific contents of v2.1.0 unchanged while correcting the public provenance of the source-transformation pipeline: it archives and distinguishes the archive-write stripping implementation used for historical transformed B/C artifacts, the later historical analysis-time implementation that already preserved public API names, and the current stripping implementation. It includes 450 raw consistency checks and 1,800 transformed-artifact behavioral re-oracle checks; of the 1,800 transformed checks, 630 fail behavioral preservation after a historical public-API renaming defect propagated through cumulative transformation levels. The release also includes evidence-removal baseline analyses, unconditional and behavior-preserving auditor-stability summaries, failure-taxonomy outputs, and headline-result traceability. All headline results can be verified from archived artifacts without new LLM generation or paid API calls. The study is intentionally scoped to controlled, contract-bound process auditing of generated Python code and does not claim general-purpose process recovery or external transfer of the archived auditors.
